"""Exercises complete Python declaration documentation."""

__all__ = ["PublicService", "build_result", "_ExportedService", "_exported_helper"]


class PublicService:
    """Run a representative public service operation."""

    def execute(self) -> None:
        """Execute the representative service operation."""


def build_result() -> str:
    """Build the representative service result."""
    return "result"


def _private_helper() -> None:
    pass


class _ExportedService:
    """Represent a private-named service intentionally included in the public API."""

    def run(self) -> None:
        """Run the exported service operation."""


def _exported_helper() -> None:
    """Run the private-named helper intentionally included in the public API."""
